a.speaker: dutch
a.text: Well, look at that jawline. You've got his jawline. Hold still, I'll get your good side.

b.speaker: cass
b.text: You went back to the car at three in the morning.

c.speaker: dutch
c.text: Four minutes past. I'm a professional. Fire bars, doubled. Pads, pulled. Extinguishers, emptied into the sand. Tommy even waved at me.

d.speaker: dutch
d.text: Fire's honest, kid. It doesn't care who the star is.

e.speaker: pa
e.text: WE ARE LIVE IN FIVE. FOUR. THREE...

a2.speaker: narration
a2.text: Stage Nine. A live studio audience of four hundred mannequins, every one in a party hat. The APPLAUSE sign is already lit.
